_comment: SYNTHETIC cases for part B. notes are numbered N1.. in this order; contradicting_notes are 1-based indexes of the notes that really contradict the answer.

review_cases.question: On which address does llama-server listen on a node?
review_cases.answer: On a node the llama-server binds to the loopback address 127.0.0.1 only.
notes: node-amd has an AMD GPU with 16 GB VRAM.

review_cases.question: How do I check which model is loaded on node-amd?
review_cases.answer: Open the Nodes page in the hub GUI and look at the loaded models of node-amd.

review_cases.question: Which protocol does a node use to reach the hub?
review_cases.answer: A node opens an outbound TLS connection to the hub and keeps one session open. The node itself opens no listening port.

review_cases.question: How much VRAM does node-amd have?
review_cases.answer: node-amd has 8 GB of VRAM.

review_cases.question: When does the backup run?
review_cases.answer: The nightly backup of node-amd runs at 05:40 every day.
notes: The nightly backup of node-amd runs at 03:15.

review_cases.question: How much VRAM does node-nvidia have?
review_cases.answer: node-nvidia has 24 GB of VRAM.

review_cases.question: Which port does the hub use?
review_cases.answer: The hub accepts connections on port 8443.

review_cases.question: How much RAM does node-amd have?
review_cases.answer: node-amd has 32 GB of system RAM.
notes: node-amd has an AMD GPU with 16 GB of VRAM.

review_cases.question: Where does the nightly backup write its files?
review_cases.answer: The backup writes its archive into the backup folder on the hub host.
notes: The nightly backup of node-amd runs at 03:15.

review_cases.question: Which database does the hub use?
review_cases.answer: The hub stores everything in PostgreSQL.

review_cases.question: Does node-laptop have a dedicated GPU?
review_cases.answer: No, node-laptop has no dedicated GPU.
notes: node-amd has an AMD GPU with 16 GB of VRAM.

review_cases.question: Which port does the hub use?
review_cases.answer: The hub accepts connections on port 8080.

review_cases.question: Which GPU does node-nvidia have?
review_cases.answer: node-nvidia has an AMD GPU.
notes: node-nvidia has an NVIDIA GPU with 24 GB of VRAM.
node-amd has an AMD GPU with 16 GB of VRAM.

review_cases.question: Give me the hub port and the backup time.
review_cases.answer: The hub listens on port 8443 and the nightly backup of node-amd runs at 01:00.
notes: The nightly backup of node-amd runs at 03:15.

review_cases.question: On which address does llama-server listen on a node?
review_cases.answer: On a node the llama-server listens on 0.0.0.0.
notes: llama-server on a node binds to 127.0.0.1 only.

review_cases.question: When does the backup of node-amd run?
review_cases.answer: The nightly backup of node-amd starts a quarter past three at night.
notes: The nightly backup of node-amd runs at 03:15.

review_cases.question: What hardware does node-amd have?
review_cases.answer: node-amd has an AMD GPU with 16 GB of VRAM.

review_cases.question: What runs on node-alpha?
review_cases.answer: The hub and its PostgreSQL database run in containers on node-alpha.
notes: node-alpha is the server that hosts the production hub.

review_cases.question: What runs on node-alpha?
review_cases.answer: The reverse proxy for the GUI does not run on the hub host but on a separate machine.
notes: node-alpha is the server that hosts the production hub.

review_cases.question: What runs on node-amd?
review_cases.answer: On node-amd the model server runs next to the node program and talks to it over loopback.
notes: node-amd is the gaming PC of the operator.
